title: As great as the book!
body: The interface is easy to understand, has no fluff, and in an encouraging format.
author: Nerdy Erin

title: Great app overall but pricy
body: Clean interface, effective system, very interactive, easy to use, and appealing to the eyes. Although, very expensive haha
author: Kanerii

title: Enjoying it
body: I love the overall design of the app, very simple but functional 💜 I love it!
author: roxie🥀

title: Finally, they have made an app
body: This a good companion of the book. The whole interface is straightforward. You’re structured to complete a habit and realistic as well. Kudos to the team.
author: Valdoria karen

title: Atoms App Review
body: The daily lessons is an awesome feature - I hope they remain in the “free” version so James can continue to help those with limited resources who need help the most.
author: mariloupm

title: Great app but too pricey
body: So far, a wonderful app. I’m impressed by the thought and effort that went into its development as well as the features it provides. However, my enthusiasm is dampened by the app’s pricing. I agree with some of the comments that it’s too expensive. While I understand that quality comes at a cost, I find the price point to be on the higher side. At this stage, I would need to delve deeper into the app and use its features more extensively to determine whether the price is justified by the value it provides

title: Great app
body: Easy to use and intuitive. Highly recommended. Hope it helps us build better versions of ourselves.
author: ahehenemdsm

title: Rather Expensive
body: I agree with the other comments saying the subscription is too expensive. And only 1 habit for the free version. I love the book and I try to live by its teachings. Maybe I will stick to the manual habit tracking. Great app though - user interface is super intuitive, minimal, and efficient.
author: Zeng D.

title: Intuitive
body: The interface is quite intuitive and fun to look at. Looking forward to developing my habits with this app
author: Morris Medel

title: Great App to be on track again
body: Great app to remind us daily to be in track of good habits build on them daily thru this app.
author: MrClutch1234

title: Big & Warm Thank You!
body: I was thrilled and downloaded the app! So easy logging in.  I was able to log my 1st habit and looking forward to exploring more! I like the simplicity but vibrant colors.  Thank you!
author: chuacloset

title: Clean interface
body: I enjoy how simple and clean your app looks. Less complications and stuff to navigate. More focused on its purpose. Much like your book. Thank you for this. Will continue to give further reviews for improvements.
author: Lassie516

title: Too expensive
body: I feel the subscription is too expensive. Maybe I’m not the target market.
author: cesph
